paite: Huan, Abrahamin ji dang a neia, amin Ketura ahi.
english: Abraham took another wife, and her name was Keturah.

paite: Huan, aman Joksante, Jedante, Midiante, Isbakte, Suahte a neihsaka.
english: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.

paite: Huan, Joksan in tapa Sheba leh Dedan a neia. Huan, Dedan tapate tuh Assurim te, Letusim te ahi uh.
english: Jokshan became the father of Sheba, and Dedan. The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.

paite: Huan, Midian tapate Ephate, Epherte, Hanokte, Abidate, Eldate ahi uh. Huai tengteng Ketura tate ahi uhi.
english: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.

paite: Huan, Abrahamin aneih tengteng Isaak kiangah a pia.
english: Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac,

paite: A mei tapate kiangah bel Abrahamin kipahmante a pia a; huan, amah a damlai in a tapa Isaak kianga kipan suahlam ah suahlam gamah, a pai mangsak hi.
english: but to the sons of Abraham’s concubines, Abraham gave gifts. He sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, to the east country.

paite: Huan, Abraham damsung kum za khat leh kum sawm sagih leh kum nga ahi.
english: These are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived: one hundred seventy-five years.

paite: Huan, Abrahamin a kha a khahta hi, lu a kelsam pou vekin putek pi, tekkuna damin a sia, a chipihte kiangah piin a om samta hi.
english: Abraham gave up the spirit, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people.

paite: Huan, a tapa Isaak leh Ismaelin Hit mi Zohar tapa Ephron loua, Mamre phak maa Makpel kokhuk ah a vuita ua;
english: Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre,

paite: Huai lou Abrahamin Heth suante akipana a leisa ahi: huailaiah Abraham a vui ua, a zi Sara toh.
english: the field which Abraham purchased of the children of Heth. Abraham was buried there with Sarah, his wife.

paite: Huan, hichi ahia, Abraham sih nungin, Pathianin a tapa Isaak a vualzawla; huan, Isaak Beer-lahai-roi kiangah a om hi.
english: It happened after the death of Abraham that God blessed Isaac, his son. Isaac lived by Beer Lahai Roi.

paite: Huan, hiaite Abraham tapa Ismael, Sara sikhanu Aigupta mi Haharin Abraham a neihsak suante ahi uh:
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s handmaid, bore to Abraham.

paite: Hiaite a min chiat uleh a suante uh bang jelin Ismael tapate min ahi uh: Ismael ta upapen Nabaioth ahia; a naute Kedarte, Adbeelte, Mibsamte.
english: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to the order of their birth: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

paite: Mismate, Dumate, Massate ahi ua;
english: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,

paite: Hadadate, Temate, Jeturte, Naphisate leh Kedemte leng ahi uh:
english: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.

paite: Tuate Ismael tapate ahi uh: huaite a khua uh bang leh a giahbuk uh bangjela a min uh gelh ahi; achi uh bangjelin kumpipa sawm leh nih ahi uh.
english: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments: twelve princes, according to their nations.

paite: Huan, Ismael damsung kum hiai zah ahi; kum ja leh kum sawm thum leh kum sagih; huan, a kha akhah a, a sia, a chipihte kiangah piin a om samta.
english: These are the years of the life of Ishmael: one hundred thirty-seven years. He gave up the spirit and died, and was gathered to his people.

paite: Huan, a tapate Havila gam akipanin Assuria gam lamsanga Aigupta gam phak maa Sur tanin a om ua: a unau tengteng kiang nai ah a om hi.
english: They lived from Havilah to Shur that is before Egypt, as you go toward Assyria. He lived opposite all his relatives.

paite: Huan, hiaite Abraham tapa Isaak suante ahi uh: Abrahamin tapa Isaak a neia:
english: This is the history of the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son. Abraham became the father of Isaac.

paite: Isaak in Paddan-aram gama Suria mi Bethuel tanu, Suria mi Laban sanggamnu Rebeka a ji dinga a neih laiin kum sawm li a upa ahi.
english: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan Aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian, to be his wife.

paite: Huan, a ji a chin jiakin Isaakin Toupa a ji adingin nget petmahin a ngetsak a: huan, Toupan a ngetna a ngaihkhiak saka, huchiin a ji Rebeka a gai.
english: Isaac entreated Yahweh for his wife, because she was barren. Yahweh was entreated by him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

paite: Huan, a nau paite a sungah a kisual ua; huan, aman, hichi bang ahih ngal leh, bangjiakin ahia ka hin leh? Achia. Huchiin Toupa dong dingin a kuantaa.
english: The children struggled together within her. She said, “If it be so, why do I live?” She went to inquire of Yahweh.

paite: Huan, Toupan, a kiangah, Na sul ah chi nih a om uh, na gil sunga kipanin nam nih a kikhen ding uh: nam khat nam khat sangin ahatzaw dinga; huan, a upa jawin a naupangjaw na a sem ding achia.
english: Yahweh said to her, “Two nations are in your womb. Two peoples will be separated from your body. The one people will be stronger than the other people. The elder will serve the younger.”

paite: Huan, a nau neih a hunin, ngaiin, a sul ah phik a hong omta ua.
english: When her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.

paite: Huan a masajaw a sana san seksawk, puan mulbanga mul thiapthuapin a hongpawta, huchiin amin dingin Esau a sa uh.
english: The first came out red all over, like a hairy garment. They named him Esau.

paite: Huai nungin a nau a pawt nawna, a khut in Esau khetul a len gige a; huchiin amah min dingin Jakob a sa uh: huan, Rebekain amaute a neih laiin Isaak kum sawm guka upa ahi.
english: After that, his brother came out, and his hand had hold on Esau’s heel. He was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when she bore them.

paite: Huan, naupangte a hongkhangliana ua: huan, Esau sabet siam, gammi ahi a; Jakob bel mi mawl, puanin a teng mi ahi.
english: The boys grew. Esau was a skillful hunter, a man of the field. Jacob was a quiet man, living in tents.

paite: Huan, Isaakin, a sakhi sa a nek jel jiakin, Esau a ita; Rebekain bel Jakob a it jaw hi.
english: Now Isaac loved Esau, because he ate his venison. Rebekah loved Jacob.

paite: Huan, Jakobin be a huana; huan, Esau gam kuan a hongtunga, a tawl mahmaha:
english: Jacob boiled stew. Esau came in from the field, and he was famished.

paite: Huan Esauin Jakob kiangah, hehpihtakin na be huan hon nesak in; ka bah mahmah mai, achia. Huaijiakin ahi, a min dia Edom a chih uh.
english: Esau said to Jacob, “Please feed me with that same red stew, for I am famished.” Therefore his name was called Edom.

paite: Huan, Jakobin, na ta masa hihna honleisak phot lechin, achia.
english: Jacob said, “First, sell me your birthright.”

paite: Huan, Esauin, Ngaiin, si dekdek ka hi ngala: ta masa hihna kia kei dingin bang a phatuam dia? A chia.
english: Esau said, “Behold, I am about to die. What good is the birthright to me?”

paite: Huan, Jakobin, Tuniin ka kiangah kichiam photin, achia; huan, a kiangah a kichiama: huchiin ata masa hihna Jakob kiangah a khawng maimah ta.Huan, Jakobin Esau tanghou leh a be huan a piaa; huchiin a ne a, a dawna, a thoua, a paita; Huchibangin Esauin a ta masa hihna a ngaineu hi.
english: Jacob said, “Swear to me first.” He swore to him. He sold his birthright to Jacob.

paite: Huan, Jakobin Esau tanghou leh a be huan a piaa; huchiin a ne a, a dawna, a thoua, a paita; Huchibangin Esauin a ta masa hihna a ngaineu hi.
english: Jacob gave Esau bread and stew of lentils. He ate and drank, rose up, and went his way. So Esau despised his birthright.
